literal_meaning: to burst open and go away (like a bubble or boil bursting)
figurative_meaning_en: to leave suddenly or abruptly, to die
example_sentences_in_bangla: এখান থেকে ফুটে যাও, আর কখনো ফিরে আসবে না।
পুরোনো বন্ধুটি হঠাৎ ফুটে গেল, সবাই শোকাহত।
example_sentences_in_english: Get out of here and never come back—beat it!
The old friend suddenly passed away, leaving everyone in grief.
note: This idiom evokes the image of something bursting and vanishing instantly, common in everyday Bengali vernacular.
